assessment: Moses and Harel generate a compelling set of novel molecular tools in African turquoise killifish, including the development of gain of function and dose dependent inducible expression systems for African turquoise killifish. These tools will help boost this budding model system for broad biotechnological applications, including the study of gene function in the context of aging in a relatively fast manner compared to other vertebrate models. The authors showcase the efficacy of their tools in the context of peptide hormones involved in growth and gonad development.
